easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Stinger such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
description:
Kill Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Stinger dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
